set.pl: NW corner of sec 16 T74N R9W (Clay Twp, Washington Co): the spot named in the gallows confession, read as Clay Twp's sec 16 because the story is told in the Clay Twp chapter. In 1874 sec 16 was the school section, sold off in small lots.
pinev: 1874 Washington Co atlas p.39, caption T74N R9W (archive.org atlasofwashingto00unse, PC (b)); BLM PLSS sec 16 = 41.206-41.221, -91.907 to -91.888; NW corner. Whether the confession meant this township is not proven.
set.t: Look for an old red oak or its stump near the NW corner of sec 16; small private lots. Permission needed.
set.tovw: D: a confession reported second-hand in a 1909 county history; hunted, never found.
